fato_historico: 1821: The Treaty of Córdoba is signed in Córdoba, now in Veracruz, Mexico, concluding the Mexican War of Independence from Spain.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos hums with a vibration of liberation and new beginnings today. Much like a historical shift that once marked the dawn of autonomy in distant lands, you may feel an inner urge to break free from old cycles. It is a good time to sign your own metaphorical treaty of independence, embracing the brilliant duality that defines your spirited, curious nature.
frase_do_dia: Your path to freedom is paved with the courage to be authentically you.
significado_numero: Represents the manifestation of success and the beginning of a fresh journey.
conselho: Speak your truth clearly and walk confidently toward the new horizons awaiting you.
